title: Typography Widget
description: A heading or a line of plain text. The variant sets the look and the tag: `h1` to `h6` render that heading, `body` and `small` a paragraph. For links, lists or emphasis use `markdownText`.

textProp.description: The text, plain: a line break in it is a line break on screen. Interpolates `{{ }}` like any top-level string.

variantProp.description: The look, and the tag: `h1` to `h6` render that heading, `body` (the default) and `small` a paragraph. Headings are the page's outline for screen readers: don't skip levels.
